title: Sensitivity
description: Closed ordered FEATURE-0013 sensitivity vocabulary PUBLIC < INTERNAL < CONFIDENTIAL < RESTRICTED (F13-SEC-001; design sections 7.5/12; architecture section 12.4). Coexists with FEATURE-0012 DataClassification and never replaces or lowers it. Profile-bound rules (ceiling, content categories, max field/byte/depth/value-type limits) are declared on DecisionProfile and may raise the classification floor, never lower it. Unmapped, unknown, contradictory, or below-floor values fail closed. Structural typed conformance only; not a content-scanning engine. When referenced as a property, the referencing property declares x-sovrunn-field-policy.
